title: noccaea hastulata
intro: Noccaea hastulata, commonly known as Alpine Pennycress, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Noccaea hastulata include its antimicrobial and antifungal activities, making it useful in the treatment of various infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Noccaea hastulata include glucosinolates, which have been shown to have potential anti-cancer properties and may play a role in the prevention of certain diseases.
